text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: high 5xx rate for `redwood-api` in us-west-2 after rollout v2026-03-14_22. Pager: P1.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC123456 created and paging @rachel (on-call). Escalation policy: 5m -> @sanjay -> @ops.
rachel: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and checking canary group.
deploy-bot: Deploy v2026-03-14_22 -> redwood-api finished canary step at 22:03UTC. Canary traffic: 10%.
rachel: seeing spike in 502/503 across canary pods, error rate ~18% over 1m, latency up. `upstream read` in nginx logs.
sanjay: pinging load-balancer + health checks. any GC/OOM in pod logs?
rachel: no OOM. sample logs: ```
[2026-03-14T22:05:12Z] error: upstream read timed out, downstream 502
[2026-03-14T22:05:13Z] error: 5xx on /v1/generate - kv cache miss?
```
tilly: I see increased connection resets on the gpu-inferters behind the service. Could be new model param on this build. Which model variant was rolled?
deploy-bot: Canary uses model-ref `openlm/gigantor-3b:q8_0` (new quant profile).
james (support): customers on lowest tier seeing timeouts, some error reports from EU region. ETA on mitigation?
rachel: if canary-only, we should rollback canary to previous replica set and cut traffic back to 0%. I'm going to trigger a rollback canary now. @sanjay help with `kubectl`.
sanjay: running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=34 --namespace=prod-us-west-2` now.```

(in-thread note: reaction :eyes: on rachel's message)

sanjay: rollback applied to canary replica set. Confirming pods are back to previous image. New canary pods are terminating.
rachel: scaling canary to 0% traffic via envoy config: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/_routes/canary -d 'weight=0'` -> 200 OK.
ops: good, traffic cut. Observability: error rate falling back to baseline within 90s.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident escalated to @sanjay per policy.
pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC123456 acknowledged by rachel at 22:07UTC.
james (support): informing affected customers: posting status update to status page and opening support tickets for those who contacted us. Template: "We're rolling back a recent canary due to increased errors; no data loss expected; updates soon."
rachel: quick root-cause triage: symptoms point to mismatch between new quant kernel and runtime path causing stalled inference calls -> upstream timeouts. We'll open a postmortem and block that quant profile until validated.
sanjay: adding temporary alert to suppress flapping during full rollback: `silence INC123456` on PagerDuty for 30m.
ops: verifying metrics: 5xx rate returned to normal at 22:09UTC, p95 latency back to 120ms.
tilly: note for release team: revert quant profile flag in next patch and add integration test exercising long-tail latency under production sequence lengths.
rachel: handing off to oncall-sre for 08:00 shift to follow up with postmortem and customer comms. Handoff summary: rolled back canary, traffic 0% to canary, error baseline restored, root-cause suspected quant kernel/runtime mismatch, PD incident suppressed, postmortem required.
ops: added tasks to incident tracker: ["capture failing request traces","validate quant kernels","add canary smoke tests"].
pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC123456 resolved by rachel at 22:12UTC. :white_check_mark:
james (support): posting resolved update to status page and emailing affected customers with next steps.
rachel: thumbnails: all services healthy, leaving monitoring for 30m, will update thread if anything else. Great quick response team. :heart:
(reacts :thumbsup: from tilly, :tada: from ops)
